name: Pipeline stage numeral steps through parse-to-render
looks: On a near-black ground with a faint amber code-scroll texture, a huge outline numeral and a short stage label sit in the corner (01, then 02 PARSE). As the stage advances, the main panel swaps from raw source code to a branching tree diagram, each node labelled by a thin leader line, then on to a styled rendered document, always in sync with the numeral change.
build: Numeral+label cross-fade 150-200ms on each stage change, cued to the same beat as the main panel swap. Tree diagram nodes connect to their labels with straight leader-line strokes drawing on (`strokeDashoffset`), each landing 60-100ms after its parent node settles.
sound: A short digital blip on each stage change, pitched a step higher per stage; a soft tick per leader line landing.
prompt: Mark a short technical pipeline's stages with a huge numeral and label in the corner, swapping the main content between raw input, an annotated structural diagram with leader-line labels on each part, and a finished rendered output, the numeral and the content always changing together on the same beat.
